meta.u_axis_source: extract_circuit.py optic_channels (mean PRE-synapse position, min-max normalized over optic neurons)

provenance_separation.inferred_column: MODEL-ASSUMED lattice + SOURCE-DERIVED nearest-node assignment, with column_confidence
provenance_separation.receptive_field: UNKNOWN — deliberately not claimed; a centroid is not an RF and no RF measurements exist in this workspace
provenance_separation.stimulus_mapping: the declared nearest-node convention in stimulus_map

meta.cell_type_status: UNKNOWN for all neurons (Stage B reserved field); therefore column identity is NOT verified per cell type

stimulus_map.convention: stimulus intensity I(u,v) in [0,1]; a neuron's drive = I(nearest column node (u,v)) — nearest-node binning, no interpolation (declared approximation, reproducible)
stimulus_map.axes: u = normalized particle-x axis (elevation in the 3D scene), v = normalized particle-y axis (azimuth). NOTE: the legacy 8-bin formula `(u*4|0)+((v*2|0)*4)` indexes channels 0-3 by the FIRST (elevation) term — see P1_BIOLOGY_AUDIT.md E1. This grid keeps the data's own axes and does NOT reproduce the legacy mislabel.
